parsed.rationale: I don't agree that this ECG is normal: it shows sinus rhythm with an rSR' pattern and a broad terminal R' in V1 (with secondary T-wave inversion in V1–V2), plus a wide slurred terminal S wave in I, V5 and V6 and a terminal R in aVR, which together point to right bundle branch block without any ST elevation that meets STEMI criteria.
